title: Supporting research on AI and children’s safety
summary: OpenAI commits $2 million to research on AI and children’s safety. The work supports shared tools to measure risks and opportunities for young people.
reason: OpenAI's $2M research-funding commitment is a philanthropic grant announcement, not a named model release, new research result/paper, business financing/M&A/partnership, policy action, or OSS tool launch. No active rule covers it.
